intro: Frontier3DBench evaluates coding agents through executable 3D creation: detailed objects, composed scenes, and interactive open worlds.

method.title: Specify
method.text: Reference images, task briefs, and initial assets define the target geometry, appearance, and behavior.

method.title: Build
method.text: Coding agents create editable Blender scenes and Unreal Engine projects with executable construction and interaction code.

method.title: Execute
method.text: Independent evaluation renders delivered assets, inspects geometry, and runs interactions and continuous workflows.

method.title: Measure
method.text: Visual fidelity, structural consistency, and task fulfillment produce a unified 0–100 score.

figures.title: From task specifications to editable projects
figures.description: Agents generate executable code and editable Blender or Unreal Engine projects.

figures.title: Strengths across nine task families
figures.description: A unified benchmark reveals complementary strengths across objects, scenes, and interactive worlds.

figures.title: Appearance. Structure. Task fulfillment.
figures.description: Three capability profiles distinguish visual fidelity, structural consistency, and completion of the requested task.

figures.title: Quality and cost efficiency
figures.description: Luna, DeepSeek, and Sol trace the quality–cost frontier at the paper’s estimated API costs.

score.aggregation: Task scores are averaged within each level, then combined with 30% / 30% / 40% weights.

components.name: Visual fidelity
components.description: Fidelity to the instruction or reference and aesthetic quality.

components.name: Requirements
components.description: Dimensions, part counts, geometric features, and spatial relations.

components.name: Detail fidelity
components.description: Coverage and implementation accuracy across measured native-scene and export variants.

components.name: Image similarity
components.description: Reference agreement in image structure, edges, color, and tone.

components.name: Object localization
components.description: Projected object placement, size, and count.

components.name: Target modification
components.description: Achievement of the requested edit within its designated region.

components.name: Preservation
components.description: Retention of protected scene content outside the edit scope.

components.name: Visual quality
components.description: Shape, construction, materials, lighting, composition, detail, and style.

components.name: Task fidelity
components.description: Environment coverage and the identity of functional areas and mechanisms.

components.name: Spatial layout
components.description: Support connectivity, penetration, traversability, and layout semantics.

components.name: Interaction correctness
components.description: Local mechanisms, moving-part clearance, and complete stateful workflows.

measurement.title: Evidence-grounded visual scoring
measurement.text: GPT-6-astra at medium reasoning effort judges predefined criteria against rendered evidence and task references, with generator identity hidden.
measurement.detail: L1/L2 visual grades use a normalized 0–4 scale. L3 uses continuous evidence anchors for six appearance criteria and task fidelity.

measurement.title: Reference alignment
measurement.text: Image structure, color, tone, edges, and projected object locations ground reconstruction in its reference.

measurement.title: Native project inspection
measurement.text: Blender execution checks loading, editable geometry, dependencies, dimensions, and task-specific constraints. Detail fidelity follows the weakest measured variant.

measurement.title: Independent world evaluation
measurement.text: A trusted observer rebuilds the submitted Unreal Engine project in a separate workspace and records geometry, actions, trajectories, and persistent state.

measurement.title: Interactions in context
measurement.text: Local mechanisms, moving-part clearance, and continuous workflows measure whether a world supports complete activities.
measurement.formula: H = 0.40 local mechanisms + 0.25 motion clearance + 0.35 state/workflow

human_agreement.title: Aligned with human judgments
human_agreement.description: Eight raters ranked four candidates on 45 reference-conditioned tasks, producing 360 rankings.

findings.title: Leadership changes with the task
findings.text: Sol leads overall at 66.02; Astra leads interactive worlds at 61.28; Opus leads text-to-object generation at 84.05.

findings.title: Quality and cost efficiency
findings.text: Luna, DeepSeek, and Sol define the estimated quality–cost frontier at $0.27, $0.45, and $1.01 per task.

findings.title: Human-aligned evaluation
findings.text: Automatic reference-fidelity rankings achieve 0.727 Kendall τb and 79.2% top-one agreement with human judgments.

cost_accounting.definition: Estimated generation API cost per task, using cost-range midpoints and each task’s final successful attempt; ordinary input, cache-read, cache-write, and output tokens are priced separately.
cost_accounting.figure_uncertainty: 95% task-bootstrap intervals, 100,000 resamples, retaining 30/30/40 level weights.
